item.title: [−1] Sensex falls 876 points to 73,852.90 and Nifty 1.11% to 22,888.95; private banks and IT lead losses
item.description:
Private banks fell about 1.9% and IT 1.3%, while state-run banks rose 2.5%. Decliners outnumbered gainers 2,925 to 1,163. Snaps a two-day rally; markets are shut on 20 October for Dussehra.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — IT down 1.3%

Why it matters: Crude near $110 and renewed foreign selling hit heavyweights; broad selling shows risk appetite is fragile despite trade-deal hopes.
